capabilities: Render a vault CSV file as a table inside a note via a code block
Filter displayed rows with filtrex filter expressions
Sort rows with sort expressions, including direction control
Select, rename, and compute columns with expressions
Configure csv-parse options such as delimiter handling and date casting
extras: The README includes a detailed 1.2-to-1.3 upgrade section documenting behavior changes, including the new Obsidian 1.13.1 minimum requirement.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display the contents of a CSV file as a table inside a note.
summary: Code-block plugin that renders a CSV file from the vault as a table, with column selection, row filtering, and sorting via expressions.
